info.name: ReadyCare API POC
info.description:
Current ReadyCare API collection.

Suggested MVP flow:
1. Auth / Register Professional
2. Auth / Register Client
3. Auth / Login Admin
4. Users / Get Me (Client Token) - captures {{addressId}}
5. Document Types / Get Document Types - captures {{documentTypeId}}
6. Professionals / Upload My Document
7. Professionals / Submit My Application
8. Admin / Review Document
9. Admin / Approve Professional
10. Availability / Create Availability
11. Bookings / Create Booking
12. Bookings / Accept Booking
13. Bookings / Complete Booking
14. Bookings / Create Review

Protected requests use bearer token variables captured by auth requests.
